symptom: A layout mxcli wrote renders with **no topbar bar and no sidebar rail** — the widgets are all there and in the right regions, but unstyled. `mx check` is 0 errors and the BSON looks right
cause: The layout's own `Forms$Appearance.Class` was empty. Atlas scopes **24** of its layout rules to `.layout-atlas` and its variants, and every Atlas layout with chrome carries one (`layout-atlas layout-atlas-responsive-topbar`, `…-responsive-default`; only `PopupLayout` is bare). `CREATE LAYOUT` had no `class:` property at all, so every layout it wrote was unstyled
insight: **A CSS class on a layout is API, not decoration** — it is how the design system's rules find the layout at all. No check mxcli or mxbuild has can see this: the document is valid, the build is clean, and the difference is only visible in a browser next to the layout being replaced. That comparison *is* the test (`.claude/skills/verify-in-runtime.md`). The same reasoning applies to the flex design properties on `topbar-content`: Atlas sets the flex direction as a design property rather than in the class, so a container without them stacks its children in the corner
